Home recommends unread titles by matching genre metadata from your recently read manga.
Manga Details now summarizes live unread, downloaded and bookmarked chapter counts.
improved: Persistent search, category filters, sorting, range selection, continue-reading and global search on the new Library grid.
Cinematic manga details, chapter reading progress, Start/Continue controls and bookmark-aware chapter cards.
Reader tools now have labels, a reading-room page/percentage indicator and a visual progress bar in Obsidian.
Preserves com.selura.manga, permanent signing, source IDs, backups and existing reading data.
fixed: Continue Reading resumes the historical partial chapter or advances after a completed chapter.
